上游鋰資源：公司通過在全球範圍內的鋰礦資        Upstream lithium resources: The Company’s worldwide lithium resource
源佈局，分別在澳大利亞、阿根廷、愛爾蘭和        footprint, including Australia, Argentina, Ireland, and Qinghai and Jiangxi
中國青海、江西等地，掌控了多處優質鋰礦資        Province in China, enables us to operate several high-quality lithium
源，形成了穩定、優質、多元化的原材料供         resources, which gives us a stable, high-quality, diverse raw materials
應體系。大部分礦產資源簽訂了長期採購協         supply chain system. The Company has entered into long-term procurement
議。公司現用的主要鋰資源為澳大利亞Mount      agreements with regard to a majority of such lithium resources. Lithium
Marion項目。公司通過持續投資上游鋰資源公     resources currently used by the Company are mainly sourced from the
司及簽署長期戰略採購協議，保障與鞏固了上        Mount Marion Project in Australia. The Company has ensured and cemented
游優質鋰原材料的穩定供應。               the stable supply of upstream lithium raw materials with prime quality
                            through continuously investing in upstream lithium resource companies and
                            entering into long-term strategic procurement agreements.

鋰化合物：贛鋒生態系統的核心為鋰化合物業        Lithium compounds: At the core of the Ganfeng Ecosystem is the lithium
務板塊，主要產品包括(1)電池級氫氧化鋰，       compounds business segment, mainly including (1) battery-grade lithium
(2)電池級碳酸鋰，(3)氯化鋰，(4)氟化鋰等，   hydroxide; (2) battery-grade lithium carbonate; (3) lithium chloride; (4) lithium
廣泛應用於電動汽車、便攜式電子設備等鋰電        fluoride, etc. Such lithium compounds are widely used as lithium battery
池材料及化學及製藥領域，客戶主要包括全球        materials for electric vehicles, portable electronics, as well as in chemical
電池正極材料製造商、電池供應商和汽車原始        and pharmaceutical fields. Our customers primarily consist of global battery
設備製造廠商。                     cathode material manufacturers, battery suppliers and automobile original
                            equipment manufactures.

金屬鋰：公司的金屬鋰產品產能排名全球第         Lithium metals: The lithium metals production capacity of the Company
一。公司能夠根據客戶需要生產不同規格型號        ranks No. 1 globally. The Company is capable of producing lithium metals
及厚度的金屬鋰錠、鋰箔、鋰棒、鋰粒子、鋰        in the form of ingots, foil, rods, particles, alloy powder as well as copper
合金粉及銅鋰或鋰鋁合金箔，主要用於(1)鋰       lithium or lithium aluminum alloy foil in a range of sizes and thickness
電池負極材料；(2)醫藥反應催化劑；(3)合金     according to customers’needs, which are mainly used (1) as lithium battery
及其他工業品材料，客戶包括電池製造商及醫        anode materials; (2) as pharmaceutical catalysts; and (3) in alloys and other
藥企業。金屬鋰原料主要是氯化鋰，來自公司        industrial product materials. Our customers consist of battery manufacturers
鋰化合物業務板塊及鋰電池回收業務板塊的內        and pharmaceutical companies. Raw materials of our lithium metals are,
部供應，以及從醫藥企業含鋰催化劑溶液中回        mainly lithium chloride from the internal supply of the Company’s lithium
收的氯化鋰。                      compounds and lithium battery recycling business segments as well as
                            lithium chloride recycled from the catalyst solution which we recover from
                            the pharmaceutical companies.
鋰電池：公司大部分使用自鋰化合物業務板塊
的客戶處採購的負極材料、正極材料及電解液        Lithium batteries: The Company produces lithium-ion batteries, mainly using
生產鋰離子電池，主要用於電動汽車、各種儲        a majority of anodes materials, cathodes materials and electrolyte solutions
能設備及各種消費型電子設備，包括手機、平        sourced from its customers of the lithium compounds business segment.
板、筆記本電腦、TWS耳機、無人機等。公        Such batteries are mainly used in electric vehicles, a variety of energy
司積極推進固態鋰電池的研發、生產和商業化        storage equipment and all kinds of consumer electronic devices, such as
應用。                         mobile phones, tablets, laptops, TWS headsets, drones, etc. Meanwhile,
                            the Company also proactively carries forward the research, development,
                            production and commercial application of solid-state lithium batteries.
鋰電池回收：電動汽車及消費型電子產品的使
用必將帶動退役鋰電池處理的社會需求不斷增        Lithium battery recycling: As the use of electric vehicles and consumer
加，公司開展鋰電池回收業務市場前景廣闊，        electronic products will certainly lead to an escalating social demand for
經濟潛力巨大，並可進一步豐富了鋰原料的多        treatment of retired lithium batteries, the Company’s lithium battery recycling
元化供應渠道，實現鋰、鎳、鈷、錳等金屬的        business will have a promising market as well as enormous economic
資源綜合循環利用。公司回收退役鋰電池業務        potential. It can also further enrich the diversified supplies of lithium raw
為電池生產商及電動汽車生產商提供了可持續        materials from various sources, thus realizing the comprehensive recycling
的增值解決方案，進一步鞏固與來自電池生產        of the resources of metals such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, etc.
業務客戶的關係。                    The Company’s engagement in recycling retired lithium batteries provides
                            battery manufacturers and electric vehicles producers with sustainable
                            value-added solutions, further solidifies its relationship with customers from
                            its battery production business.

     利潤分配政策                                           PROFITS DISTRIBUTION POLICIES

     根據本公司之公司章程，公司的利潤分配政策                             According to the Articles of Association of the Company, the profits
     如下：                                              distribution policies of the Company are as follows:

     •     利潤分配原則：公司實施積極的利潤分                          •    Profit distribution principle: The Company implements a positive
           配政策，重視對投資者的合理投資回                                profit distribution policy, pays attention to the reasonable return on
           報，並保持連續性和穩定性，同時兼顧                               investment of investors, and maintains continuity and stability while
           公司的可持續發展。利潤分配不得超過                               taking into account the sustainable development of the Company.
           累計可分配利潤的範圍，不得損害公司                               The profit distribution shall not exceed the scope of accumulated
           持續經營能力；                                         distributable profits and shall not impair the Company’s ability to
                                                           continue to operate as a going concern;
     •     利潤分配形式：公司可以采取現金、股
           票或者現金與股票相結合的方式分配                           •    Form of profit distribution: The Company may distribute dividends in
           股利，優先采用現金分紅的利潤分配方                               the form of cash, stocks or a combination of cash and stocks, and
           式。                                              preferentially use cash for dividend distribution.

     •     公司一般按照年度進行利潤分配，在有                          •    The Company generally makes profit distribution on an annual basis.
           條件的情況下，董事會可以提議公司進                               Subject to the relevant conditions, the Board may propose that the
           行中期利潤分配。                                        Company make profit distribution for the interim period.

     •     現金分紅比例：在滿足公司正常生產營                          •    Proportion of cash dividends: To the extent that the funds for
           運所需資金的情況下，公司在當年盈利                               the Company’s normal production and operation are satisfied,
           且累計未分配利潤為正值的情況下，采                               the Company is profitable in the current year and the cumulative
           取現金方式分配股利，每年以現金方式                               undistributed profits are positive, dividends may be distributed in
           分配的利潤應當不少於當年實現的可分                               cash. The profits distributed in cash each year shall not be less than

  公允價值計量                  Fair value measurement

  本集團在各報告期末，以公允價值計量       The Group measures its equity investments at fair value at the end of
  其股權投資。公允價值是指在計量日，       each reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be received
  市場參與者在正常交易活動中銷售資產       to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
  收到或者清償債務所支付的金額。公允       between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value
  價值計量基於假設銷售資產或清償債務       measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to
  的交易發生於該資產或負債的主要市        sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the principal
  場，或者在缺失主要市場的情況下，發       market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal
  生於在最有利於該資產或負債的市場。       market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability. The
  主要市場或者最優市場必須是本集團可       principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible by
  以參與的市場。資產或負債的公允價值       the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using
  乃基於市場參與者在釐定資產或負債的       the assumptions that market participants would use when pricing
  定價時所使用的假設計量，並假設市場       the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their
  參與者以其最佳經濟利益行事。          economic best interest.

  非金融資產公允價值的計量需考慮市場       A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account
  參與者在最優化使用該資產或者將其銷       a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using
  售給另一個能夠最優化使用該資產的市       the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market
  場參與者的情況下產生經濟利益的能        participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.
  力。

  本集團在不同的情形下使用適當的估值       The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the

  的數據，最大化使用相關可觀測輸入        fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and
  值，最小化使用不可觀察輸入值。         minimising the use of unobservable inputs.

  可基於對公允價值計量整體而言重要的       described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is significant
  最低級別輸入值確定，層級如下：         to the fair value measurement as a whole:

         活躍市場中所報未調整價                identical assets or liabilities

              租賃－估計增量借款利率                                                            Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate

              本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利                                                      The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a
              率，因此，其使用增量借款利率（「增量                                                     lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”)
              借款利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借款利                                                     to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that the
              率為本集團須支付的利率以借入具有類                                                      Group would have to pay to borrow over a similar term, and with a
              似年期（及有類似抵押品）的必要資金以                                                     similar security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar
              在類似經濟環境下取得與使用權資產                                                       value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment. The
              有類似價值的資產。因此，增量借款利                                                      IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would have to pay”, which
              率反映了本集團「應支付」的利率，當無                                                     requires estimation when no observable rates are available (such as
              可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂立融資交                                                      for subsidiaries that do not enter into financing transactions) or when
              易的附屬公司而言）或當須對利率進行                                                      it needs to be adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the

              於逾期日數，以將具有類似損失模式                                                       rates are based on days past due for groupings of various customer

  團業務成功作出貢獻的合資格參與者提                     purpose of providing incentives and rewards to eligible participants
  供激勵及獎勵。該計劃的合資格參與者                     who contribute to the success of the Group’s operations. Eligible
  包括本公司董事、高級管理人員及核心                     participants of the Scheme include the Company’s directors, senior
  技術及管理人員。該計劃於2021年6月                   management, and core technical and management personnel. The
  7日生效。根據該計劃，本公司擬向404                   Scheme became effective on 7 June 2021. According to the Scheme,
  名計劃參與者授予15,754,000份股票期                the Company proposed to grant 15,754,000 share options to 404

  本集團以財務經理為首的財務部門負責         The Group’s finance department headed by the finance manager is
  釐定金融工具之公允價值計量的政策及         responsible for determining the policies and procedures for the fair

  並批准。                      The valuation is reviewed and approved by the chief financial officer.

  金融資產及負債的公允價值乃以該工具         The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are included
  於自願交易雙方（而非強迫或清算出售）        at the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a
  當前交易下的可交易金額入賬。以下方         current transaction between willing parties, other than in a forced or
  法及假設被用來估計公允價值：            liquidation sale. The following methods and assumptions were used
                            to estimate the fair values:

  計息銀行及其他借款的非流動部分、可         The fair values of the non-current portion of interest-bearing bank
  換股債券負債部分及其他負債的公允價         and other borrowings, the liability component of convertible bonds
  值是通過使用具類似條款，信貸風險及         and other liabilities have been calculated by discounting the expected
  剩餘期限工具現時可得的利率貼現預期         future cash flows using rates currently available for instruments with
  未來現金流量計算。於2021年12月31      similar terms, credit risk and remaining maturities. The changes in
  日的公允價值變動被評估為不重大，因         fair value as a result of the Group’s own non-performance risk for the
  為本集團本身對計息銀行及其他借款的         non-current portion of interest-bearing bank and other borrowings
  非流動部分並無履約風險。可換股債券         as at 31 December 2021 was assessed to be insignificant. The fair

  估計。                       of the Group’s own non-performance risk.



  上市金融工具的公允價值以市場報價為         The fair values of listed financial instruments are based on quoted
  基礎。董事認為，綜合財務狀況表中使         market prices. The directors believe that the estimated fair values

  槓桿作用及策略釐定可資比較公眾公司         public companies (peers) based on industry, size, leverage and

  司特定事實及情況就可比較公司之間的         discounted for considerations such as illiquidity and size differences

  現。貼現倍數適用於非上市股本投資的         facts and circumstances. The discounted multiple is applied to the
